about: Prefab homes of 70 m² or less, from the suppliers' own pages: see docs/suppliers.md. length_m x width_m is the published outside footprint; dimensions_labelled is false where the page doesn't say what the figures measure; bounding_box is true where the plan isn't a rectangle, so length x width only bounds it. A null price_nzd means the supplier doesn't publish one. appearance gives each product's roof forms and pitch from its supplier's material (empty where not published) and wall and roof colours, with their basis: a published palette, or illustrative from a render. walls_texture and roof_texture name the CC0 texture closest to its cladding and roofing (src/button_nz/blender_worker/textures); where the roofing isn't published, metal roofing is assumed.
